identityReviewRetry.reason: Hafisa's source, unlike the current near pair, supports long upswept almonds, a short low nasal centre and a broad-high-cheek to small-short-chin taper. Preserve that specific combination without imposing a rounded-eye/full-lip formula.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Native Hafisa has broad high cheeks above inward-turning lower cheeks and a small short rounded-pointed chin. Long almond apertures have raised pointed outer corners and curved lower rims. A short low bridge ends in a compact broad rounded nasal lobe. Pale blue-gray eyes, warm medium golden-brown mottled skin and dark brown uneven shoulder/upper-chest waves are visible.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Current Hafisa and Suna share a long slim central nose, almond eye spacing, fuller lip bow and tapered chin. Native Hafisa's shorter low nasal structure and broad-high-cheek to small-short-chin proportion are weakened.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Restore long upswept tapered almond apertures, the source's compact low rounded nasal centre and high-wide-cheek to small short chin taper; do not inflate lips.
